MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The Fire TV Stick feels like a useful addition to my TV and DVD setup because it would let me try streaming, even though my 720p TV would not benefit from 4K.",
    "The Fire HD 10 builds on my Fire 7 use with a larger screen and more built-in storage, giving me a concrete reason to consider an upgrade."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The Echo speakers, smart display, and smart plug assume I want voice control or home automation, but I do not currently have a use for those features.",
    "My tripods and lens cap support photography; they do not imply that I need doorbell or surveillance cameras.",
    "Another 16 GB Fire 7 fits my existing interests but offers little reason to replace the one I already own, while earbuds do not address my current accessory needs."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Owning a Fire tablet seems to have been taken as interest in a much wider range of Amazon devices, although the shared brand is not what makes an item useful to me.",
    "My electronics purchases seem to have been treated as broad interest in connected gadgets, overlooking the specific jobs my accessories serve."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "I repeatedly buy memory cards, readers, cases, cables, and mounts, so compatibility with equipment I already use matters when I choose my next accessory.",
    "A useful upgrade needs to add something I lack, such as screen space or storage; another device with the same capacity is less compelling.",
    "My power strips provide additional outlets, which is a different need from controlling a single outlet through a smart plug."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "You recognized my tablet and TV interests, but stretched them into smart-home interests while giving too little weight to practical accessories and meaningful upgrades."
}
